τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’
τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τανηλεγέος: τανηλεγής — meaning unknown (traditionally ’laying at full length’ or ’bringing long sorrow’), epithet of death; masc./fem. gen. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθαλυῖά: θάλλω — bloom, flourish; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. τεθηλώς): ’flourishing, luxuriant’
τειρεσίαο: Τειρεσίας — Tiresias, the Theban seer; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
τεοῖσι: τεός — your (sg.), of you; possessive adj., epic (Attic σός); masc./neut. dat. pl. -οισι (= Attic σοῖς)
τετληότι: τλάω — endure, have the heart to bear; perf. part. (τετληώς) masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’enduring’
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τροίηθεν: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with ablatival suffix -θεν: ‘from Troy’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’)
υἱέος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg. (υἱέος Ὀρτιλόχοιο ’son of Ortilochus’, in apposition to Diocles)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φαίδιμ: φαίδιμος — gleaming, glorious (epic epithet of heroes); masc. voc. sg., elided (φαίδιμ’ = φαίδιμε)
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg.
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’
χλαῖναι: χλαῖνα — thick woollen cloak (also used as a blanket); fem. nom. pl.
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ψυχὴ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. sg.
ψυχὴν: ψυχή — life, soul, life-breath; acc. sg.
ψυχῇ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. dat. sg., as object of χράομαι
ἀέξει: ἀέξω — make grow, increase (Attic αὐξάνω); pres. 3 sg.
ἀίδαο: Ἀΐδης (Ἅιδης) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου): ’of/in Hades’ house’
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγανοῖς: ἀγανός — gentle, mild; adj., neut. dat. pl., agreeing with βελέεσσιν
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀλλοτρίης: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard plot; gen. sg.
ἀλόχου: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. gen. sg., with πρός
ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’)
ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with an impf.-looking ending: ’took away’
ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, troublesome; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate governing an inf. · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’grievous, hard’ (δεινόν τ’ ἀργαλέον τε, of λαῖτμα)
ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg., with the masc. adjective πολιοῖο: ’of the grey sea’ (ἁλὸς πολιοῖο)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, one who shares the bed; acc. sg.
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἐίσας: ἐΐσος — well-balanced, even (sense disputed, perhaps ’equal on both sides’); fem. acc. pl. ἐίσας, agreeing with νῆας
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμή: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐννοσίγαιον: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker (epithet of Poseidon); masc. acc. sg. as a noun
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπέβην: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., root aorist: ’I mounted’
ἐπέκλωσαν: ἐπικλώθω — spin, allot by spinning (of Fate/the gods); aor. 3 pl.: ’spun out, allotted’
ἐπέσπον: ἐφέπω — follow upon, pursue, meet with; aor. 3 pl. ἐπέσπον: ’met with, incurred’ (κακὸν οἶτον ἐπέσπον ’met an evil doom’)
ἐποιχομένη: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, ply; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (ἱστὸν ἐποιχομένη ’plying the loom’) · also ’go at, come upon, assail’ (βελέεσσιν ἐποιχομένη ’coming upon him with her shafts’) · also ’go after, seek out’ (πόσιν ἐποιχομένη ’going after a husband’)
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρυκακέειν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, detain; aor. inf., reduplicated epic -κακέειν (= Attic ἐρῦξαι): ’to hold back’
ἐσάντα: ἐσάντα — face to face, straight before; adv. (ἐς + ἄντα)
ἐυεργέα: ἐϋεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= ἐϋεργῆ)
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐύπωλον: ἐΰπωλος — with fine foals, rich in horses; masc./fem. acc. sg. (two terminations; with fem. Ἴλιος)
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, a great sacrifice (orig. of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑπόμην: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 sg. mid. (= Attic εἱπόμην): ’I followed’
ἑτάροις: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl. (= Attic ἑταίροις)
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc./nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (δῶμα ἑὸν ’his own hall’)
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment
ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
ἔλθῃσι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic ἔλθῃ)
ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. acc. pl.
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθετο: ἐντίθημι — put in, lay to (heart); aor. mid. 3 sg.
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρδειν: ἔρδω — do, act, perform; pres. inf.: ’to do’
ἔρχεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf.: ’to go’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf. · also used as an imperative, a regular Homeric idiom for commands: ’hold (him) fast!’ (αὖθι δ’ ἔχειν μεμαῶτα)
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl.: ’they hold’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἔχῃ: ἔχω — hold, have, keep to; pres. subj. 3 sg.
ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
ἠερόεντα: ἠερόεις — misty, murky, dim; masc. acc. sg., with ζόφον
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ‘he came’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε)
ἦλθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you came’
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἧσται: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 sg. (= Attic κάθηται): ’sits’
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἰοχέαιρα: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-shooting (epithet of Artemis); fem. nom. sg.
ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also attributive, agreeing with δώματα: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱερὰ πρὸς δώματα)
ἱκάνεις: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 2 sg.
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ὀίω: ὀΐω — suppose, think (short-form by-word of ὀΐομαι); pres. 1 sg.
ὀιζύν: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. acc. sg.
ὀλέσας: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lost’
ὀλοφυρομένη: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail, mourn; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ὀξέι: ὀξύς — sharp; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv. · also ’back, home again’, of return (οἴκαδ’ ὀπίσσω ’back home’)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’)
ὁδίτης: ὁδίτης — wayfarer, traveller; masc. nom. sg.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’)
ὁρόω: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., epic stretched form (= Attic ὁρῶ)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑπερφιάλους: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant, presumptuous; masc. acc. pl.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’
ὠκεανὸς: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the world; masc. nom. sg.
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’ · also general, not of a sacrifice, ’do, act (to someone)’: οὔτε τινὰ ῥέξας ἐξαίσιον
ῥήγεα: ῥῆγος — rug, coverlet (laid on a bed); neut. nom./acc. pl.
